summary: Cloud media storage feature testing completed. All 23 backend API tests passed. Frontend Media Manager component verified working with Details/Media tabs, drag & drop upload zone, video link addition, and gallery management. Fixed a bug in storage_service.py where MongoDB projection queries returned empty objects for properties without media field.

issues: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

passed_tests: GET /api/admin/storage/settings - returns configuration status with all required fields
POST /api/admin/properties/{id}/media/presign - generates URL for image (returns disabled when storage off)
Property has media array field for storage
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MongoDB projection bug in storage_service.py - queries like find_one({'id': x}, {'_id': 0, 'media': 1}) returned {} for properties without media field, causing 'Property not found' errors. Fixed by including 'id' in projection.
Storage service properly handles STORAGE_ENABLED=false by returning disabled status
Video links work without cloud storage configured (YouTube/Vimeo)
Pre-signed URL generation validates file types and sizes before generating URLs
Media reordering updates both media array and images array for backward compatibility
seed_data_creation: Test properties created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloud storage feature fully tested. Storage is implemented with placeholder credentials (STORAGE_ENABLED=false). The UI shows 'Cloud Storage Not Configured' warning when not enabled. Video links can be added without cloud storage. All media management APIs (presign, confirm, video-link, delete, reorder, cover, metadata) are working correctly. Fixed a MongoDB projection bug in storage_service.py.

storage_settings_api.GET /api/admin/storage/settings: Returns enabled, provider, bucket, cdn_base, configured, max sizes, allowed types

presigned_url_api.POST /api/admin/properties/{id}/media/pr: Generates pre-signed URL for direct S3/R2 upload (returns disabled when storage off)

upload_confirm_api.POST /api/admin/properties/{id}/media/co: Confirms upload and stores metadata in database

video_link_api.POST /api/admin/properties/{id}/media/vi: Adds YouTube/Vimeo video links without cloud storage

media_management_apis.GET /api/admin/properties/{id}/media: Returns media list and images array
media_management_apis.DELETE /api/admin/properties/{id}/media/: Deletes media from storage and database

frontend_components.PropertyForm: Has Details and Media tabs (Media tab only in edit mode)
frontend_components.PropertyMediaManager: Drag & drop upload zone, video link button, storage warning, media gallery
frontend_components.VideoLinkModal: URL, thumbnail, caption fields with Add Video button

bug_fixed.issue: Video link addition returned 'Property not found' for existing properties
bug_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB projection {'_id': 0, 'media': 1} returns {} when property exists but has no media field. The check 'if not prop' passed because {} is truthy.
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'id' to projection: {'_id': 0, 'id': 1, 'media': 1} and check 'if not prop or not prop.get("id")'

mocked_apis.cloud_storage: S3/R2 uploads require real credentials. STORAGE_ENABLED=false by default. API structure is complete but actual uploads disabled.
